Title: Azure Monitor for containers now supports monitoring containers on-premises and on Azure Stack

Body.Content:
Azure Monitor for containers provides convenient out-of-the-box monitoring for all your Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) clusters. But you also have Kubernetes clusters running outside AKS. For customers who have hybrid environments, we’re now extending support to monitor Kubernetes clusters on-premises and on Azure Stack with AKS Engine (in preview). Just install the container agent along with your AKS workloads and you can create alerts and get insights into the performance of your on-premises workloads in the Azure portal.

Learn more about hybrid Kubernetes monitoring.
